Requirement_Text: The system shall respond to user requests quickly.
The application shall display the most relevant results to the user.
The system shall store user data securely.
The application shall provide an easy-to-use interface.
The system shall periodically back up the database.
The system shall provide adequate system availability.
Error messages should be helpful to the user.
The system shall be robust against failures.
The performance should degrade gracefully.
The API must be sufficiently documented.
The UI shall be aesthetically pleasing.
Search shall be fast.
The system shall scale as needed.
It should integrate seamlessly with other tools.
Notifications shall be sent promptly.
Access must be strictly controlled.
The system shall optimize the workflow.
Data integrity must be maintained perfectly.
The user experience must be intuitive.
The system will try to reconnect automatically.
The software shall be designed for maximum efficiency.
User inputs shall be processed in a reasonable timeframe.
The database must be highly secure against modern threats.
The mobile app shall load smoothly.
The architecture should support future enhancements easily.
The system shall support a large number of concurrent users.
The output report must look professional.
Network latency must be kept to an absolute minimum.
The system should gracefully handle unexpected errors.
User documentation shall be easy to read and understand.
The web interface must be fully responsive.
The backend shall process data in real-time.
The application must be completely reliable.
Data processing should be done periodically.
The payment gateway must be integrated properly.
The API shall return data efficiently.
System logs shall be reviewed regularly.
The onboarding process shall be seamless.
The software shall use state-of-the-art encryption.
Admin tasks shall be easily accessible.
The system shall return search results within 2 seconds for 95% of requests.
The system shall support 5,000 concurrent users without exceeding 70% CPU utilization.
The system shall perform a full database backup every 24 hours.
The system shall encrypt data at rest using AES-256.
The system shall lock a user account after 5 consecutive failed login attempts.
The system shall accept file uploads up to 10 MB.
The API shall rate limit requests to 1000 requests per IP address per hour.
The background job shall run at 02:00 AM UTC daily.
The application shall support English and Spanish.
The system shall store dates using ISO 8601.
The system shall complete authentication before granting access to protected resources.
The mobile application shall support iOS 15 and above.
The REST API shall return a 401 Unauthorized status code if the API key is missing.
The system shall export the audit log in CSV format.
The user profile page shall include fields for First Name, Last Name, and Email Address.
The system shall require users to change their passwords every 90 days.
The database connection pool shall have a maximum size of 50 connections.
The system shall calculate the tax rate based on the user's billing zip code.
The search query shall return a maximum of 100 results per page.
The application shall allow users to upload profile pictures in PNG or JPEG format.
The system shall timeout user sessions after 30 minutes of inactivity.
The payment module shall integrate with Stripe API v3.
The system shall compress image uploads to a maximum width of 1920 pixels.
The system shall retain logs for 365 days before automated deletion.
The application shall display an error message if the password is under 8 characters.
The database schema shall enforce referential integrity using foreign keys.
The system shall synchronize data with the master node every 5 minutes.
The web application shall pass W3C HTML5 validation without errors.
The system shall generate a monthly PDF report on the 1st of every month.
The API shall use token-based authentication via JWT.
The client app shall connect to the server over port 443.
The system shall alert the administrator via email if disk space falls below 10%.
The frontend shall be built using React version 18.
The database shall implement row-level security for tenant isolation.
The system shall provide a RESTful endpoint for retrieving user metadata.
The application shall utilize Redis for session storage.
The software shall comply with GDPR data portability requirements (Article 20).
The backend shall be deployed on AWS EC2 instances.
The system shall limit the size of a single transaction to $10,000.
The password requirements shall include at least one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one special character.
The system may cache results for up to 5 minutes.
The system should support internet explorer 11 if feasible.
User data might be temporarily stored in memory.
The interface will usually respond within 1 second.
If possible, the system shall compress image uploads.
The background process takes approximately 10 minutes.
The system could use a fallback server during outages.
Administrators ought to review logs weekly.
The software is generally expected to handle 500 concurrent connections.
The system shall preferably use a NoSQL database.
The application might need to integrate with Salesforce in the future.
Users could optionally provide their phone numbers.
The system should attempt to reconnect 3 times before failing.
Where appropriate, data shall be anonymized.
The UI should be reasonably responsive under normal load.
The system may need to support additional languages later.
As needed, the server shall allocate more RAM.
The module should log warnings when possible.
The database might experience high latency during peak hours.
The system ought to notify users of maintenance.
